title: RepurposeScore
description: The same reading as a creative score, but of work a job turned into one other format. It is its own record and not a column on the job: one job produces several formats, and each is read on its own.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

job.description: The id of the repurpose job that produced the work, in the system that ran it.

format.description: Which of the job's outputs this score is for. One score per format, so the job's own id does not identify a record.

reading.description: What the scorer made of that one output. The same shape a creative score carries, read against the channel the format is meant for.

createdAt.description: When the output was scored, which is not when the job ran.
